text: ほのおを　うけると　つよくなる

structure.jp: ほのおを　うけると
structure.en: when it is hit by Fire

patterns.name: 〜と (whenever)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb means 'whenever this happens, that always follows'. ほのおを　うけると = 'when it takes Fire'.

patterns.name: 〜くなる
patterns.explanation: A describing word with its い changed to く, plus なる, means to become that way. つよくなる = 'becomes strong'.
